gloss: farm when sunny, read when rainy

definitions.gloss: farm when sunny, read when rainy; peaceful rural life
definitions.explanation: An ideal rustic lifestyle of working in the fields on sunny days and reading indoors on rainy days; living a tranquil, self-sufficient life away from worldly concerns.

examples.japanese: {晴耕雨読|せいこううどく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{夢見|ゆめみ}て→夢見る：10543_yumemiru⟧、⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧。
examples.english: Dreaming of a peaceful rural lifestyle, I left the city.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{晴耕雨読|せいこううどく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんでいる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather enjoys a quiet life of farming and reading.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定年後|ていねんご}→定年後：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{晴耕雨読|せいこううどく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}りたい→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: After retirement, I want to live a peaceful rural life in the countryside.

notes:
STRUCTURE: {晴|せい} (sunny) + {耕|こう} (cultivate/plow) + {雨|う} (rain) + {読|どく} (read). The phrase describes the ideal rhythm of rural life: outdoor work during good weather, intellectual pursuits during bad weather.

ORIGIN: This idiom reflects the Confucian ideal of the scholar-farmer who balances practical work with intellectual cultivation. It was especially romanticized in Chinese and Japanese literature.

USAGE: Often used to describe:
- Retirement dreams of leaving city life
- An idealized simple lifestyle
- A balanced life combining physical and mental activities

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {晴耕雨読|せいこううどく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (a life of peaceful rural living)
- {晴耕雨読|せいこううどく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ (to enjoy a tranquil rural life)

CULTURAL NOTE: This idiom represents a nostalgic ideal in Japanese culture, especially appealing to those tired of urban life. It's frequently mentioned when discussing retirement plans or lifestyle changes.
